title: Advances in Artificial Intelligence: A Review for the Creative Industries

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a systematic review and does not directly measure bias. It evaluates bias through a literature review, specifically highlighting techniques like Unified Concept Editing used to ensure diverse representation and reduce gender bias in generative AI image models.
